# Formspec App Manifest Specification v2.2 (LLM Reference)

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-spec-artifacts.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Source spec: `specs/bundle/app-manifest-spec.md`
Source schema: `schemas/bundle-manifest.schema.json`

## Bottom Line Up Front

- This document defines the **App Manifest** -- a single authored JSON artifact that names a Formspec app by composing its Definitions, Surfaces, Registries, Modules, Sessions, and any combination of optional substrate documents (Experience, Response Actions, Component/Components, Theme, References, Ontology, Locales, Mappings, Data Sources) at coherent versions.
- A valid App Manifest requires `$formspecBundle: "2.0"`, `"2.1"`, or `"2.2"`, a strict SemVer `version`, a stable app-identity `id` URL distinct from every sibling URL, and a REQUIRED `definitions[]` array (MAY be empty for non-form apps; single-element for form-only apps; multi-element for multi-form apps).
- App Manifest is a pure composition envelope: no inline sidecars, no synthesis on absence, no shims on existing primary specs. Sibling absence is honored; each sibling spec's existing defaults apply.
- App Manifest adds a forward-composition graph alongside sibling-owned `targetDefinition` and `targetSurfaceRoutes[]` references. Reverse-discovery continues to work; App Manifests add discovery-without-scanning for tools that hold one.
- BREAKING vs Bundle Manifest v1.0: singular `definition` reframes as `definitions[]` (REQUIRED, MAY be empty); singular `registry` reframes as `registries[]`; `surfaces[]`, `modules: ModuleRef[]`, `sessions: SessionRef[]` arrive; `$formspecBundle` const bumps `"1.0"` → `"2.0"` so strict consumers fail loud.
- ADDITIVE vs App Manifest v2.0: `$formspecBundle: "2.1"` admits `dataSources[]`; `$formspecBundle: "2.2"` admits `components[]` and continues to admit `dataSources[]`; older 2.x documents remain valid when they do not use newer members.
- This BLUF is governed by `schemas/bundle-manifest.schema.json`, the canonical structural contract.

A single-element array is the form-only common case. Multiple Definitions support multi-form apps (e.g. an intake suite composing several screening forms). Per ADR 0150 §5.2/§5.3. |

| `#/properties/mappings` | no | array | Per-handle Mapping document references | Optional array of Mapping references, one per named mapping handle. Each entry's `handle` MUST be unique within the array. |

MUST be a strict SemVer 2.0.0 string (no leading zeros in numeric identifiers, no empty pre-release identifiers, no leading-zero numeric pre-release identifiers). ## Behavioral Essentials

- App Manifest (formerly Bundle Manifest, reframed v2.0, extended by v2.1 for Data Sources and v2.2 for Components) is a pure composition envelope: names an app by composing zero-or-more Definitions, zero-or-more Surfaces, zero-or-more Registries, optional Data Sources catalogs, optional per-handle Component documents, plus optional substrate Modules (ModuleRef[]) and Sessions (SessionRef[]) and any combination of optional single-cardinality siblings (Experience, Response Actions, legacy Component, Theme, References, Ontology) by canonical URL and version.
- Absent siblings invoke each sibling spec's existing defaults; no synthesis, no inline sidecars, no shims on existing primary specs.
- App `id` MUST be distinct from every sibling URL (singles and array entries); locales[].locale, mappings[].handle, components[].handle, definitions[].url, and dataSources[].url MUST be unique within their array.
- App `version` is strict SemVer 2.0.0; per-SiblingRef.version accepts exact SemVer or range expressions resolved at sibling-resolution time.
- `dataSources[]` is valid only when `$formspecBundle` is `"2.1"` or `"2.2"`; `components[]` is valid only when `$formspecBundle` is `"2.2"`.
- Forward composition graph (manifest → siblings) lives alongside sibling-owned targetDefinition and targetSurfaceRoutes references; reverse-discovery continues to work for tools that do not use App Manifest.
- `definitions[]` MAY be empty (non-form apps composing only surfaces/modules), single-element (form-only common case), or multi-element (multi-form apps).

## Conformance Essentials

- A conforming App Manifest must include $formspecBundle='2.0', '2.1', or '2.2', strict-SemVer version, uri-shaped id, and a REQUIRED definitions[] array (which MAY be empty).
- Processors MUST enforce array uniqueness (locale tag, mapping handle, component handle, module id, session id, definition url, dataSources url), id-vs-sibling-URL distinctness, §5.3 sibling-pin consistency, and §5.4 module coherence at resolution time.
- Loaded sibling discriminators must match the slot per the §3.4 table; Definition is identified by `$formspec` (unqualified) while every other sibling carries `$formspec<Type>`.
- Documents with $formspecBundle='1.0' (legacy Bundle Manifest) MUST be rejected — the 1.0 → 2.0 plural-shape change is BREAKING per ADR 0150 §11.2.
- Documents with dataSources[] MUST declare $formspecBundle='2.1' or '2.2'; documents with components[] MUST declare $formspecBundle='2.2'.
- App Manifest does NOT introduce shims, aliases, or backwards-compat fields on existing primary specs; existing artifacts remain unchanged.
